title: The alphabet, one letter at a time
summary: All 24 static letters, each with a plain-language handshape description and a nudge for its most common mix-up.

items.description: Make a fist and rest your thumb flat against the side of your curled fingers.
Hold your hand flat with your fingers together and pointing up, thumb folded across your palm.
Curve your hand into a C shape, letting your thumb and fingers both bend to match the curve.
Point your index finger straight up, touch your thumb to your middle finger, and curl the rest in.
Curl your fingertips down to meet your thumb, making a tight claw-like shape.
Touch your thumb to your index fingertip and hold your other three fingers straight and spread.
Point your index finger and thumb straight out, side by side, with your hand turned sideways.
Hold your index and middle fingers straight out together, turned sideways.
Make a fist and let only your pinky finger point straight up.
Form a V with your index and middle fingers and press your thumb between them at the base.
Point your index finger up and your thumb out to the side, making an L shape.
Tuck your thumb under your index, middle, and ring fingers, with your pinky resting on top.
Tuck your thumb under your index and middle fingers, with your ring and pinky curled on top.
Curve your fingers and thumb together into a rounded O shape.
Form the same shape as K, but turn your hand to point down toward the floor.
Form the same shape as G, but turn your hand to point down toward the floor.
Cross your index finger over your middle finger, resting your thumb against your other knuckles.
Make a fist and cross your thumb flat over the front of your curled fingers.
Make a fist and tuck your thumb between your index and middle fingers so it pokes out slightly.
Hold your index and middle fingers straight up together, touching, palm facing out.
Hold your index and middle fingers straight up and spread apart, palm facing out.
Hold your index, middle, and ring fingers up and spread apart, with your thumb pinning your pinky down.
Curl your index finger into a hook and rest your thumb against your curled middle finger.
Stick your thumb and pinky out to the sides and curl your other three fingers into your palm.
